scenario: [LSTR.3.2] Lexicographic order puts a proper prefix first: "ab" < "abc". Against `i.label < "abc"`, "ab" fires; "abc" (equal) and "abd" (greater at the third codepoint) do not. A comparison that stopped at the shorter length would call "ab" and "abc" equal and log nothing.
rules_ds:
schema Item scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    label: String mutable

rule hit:
    Item i where i.label < "abc"
->
    log info "{i.label}"
